codes.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The mobile number or password is not right. Check them and try again.
codes.ACCOUNT_LOCKED: Too many wrong attempts, so this account is locked for now. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
codes.ACCOUNT_LOCKED_NO_TIME: Too many wrong attempts, so this account is locked for now. Try again later.
codes.OTP_INVALID: That code is not right. Check the SMS and type it again.
codes.OTP_EXPIRED: This code has expired. Send a new code and try again.
codes.OTP_RATE_LIMITED: Too many codes were sent. Try again in {{minutes}} min.
codes.OTP_RATE_LIMITED_NO_TIME: Too many codes were sent. Try again later.
codes.NETWORK_ERROR: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
codes.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
codes.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission for this. Ask your school admin.
codes.SERVER_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a minute; if it keeps happening, contact support with the code below.
codes.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Try again; if it keeps happening, contact support with the code below.

notFound.title: Page not found

crash.title: This page couldn't open
crash.body: Reload the page. If it keeps happening, contact support with the code below.
